items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Frank Sebastian said, 'No, there's only one guy plays drums in this place, and that's Lionel.'

ctx.x: But Lionel -- with every band that came in there, even when Earl Hines came in there later, they made Earl leave his drummer out, and Lionel had to -- Frank Sebastian said, 'No, there's only one guy plays drums in this place, and that's Lionel.'
